name: Talk to Figma MCP
description: Lets Cursor, Claude Code, and other MCP agents read Figma designs and create, edit, annotate, and export nodes through a local MCP server, WebSocket relay, and Figma plugin.

skills.name: Read Designs
skills.description: Reads document info, the current selection, and node details from the open Figma file.

skills.name: Create Elements
skills.description: Creates rectangles, frames, sections, and text nodes.

skills.name: Bulk Text Updates
skills.description: Scans text nodes and updates many text contents in one batch.

skills.name: Annotations
skills.description: Reads and creates native Figma annotations, including batch updates.

skills.name: Export Nodes
skills.description: Exports a node as PNG, JPG, SVG, or PDF.
